concerns.text: T001 instructs the implementer to fetch 'the exact URL recorded in plan.md's verified-datasets block' — but plan.md's verified-datasets entry is a blank placeholder ('is: ` (CPU-score text-overlap parquet)'). No URL exists anywhere in the plan, so T001 is not executable as written; this is the same failure mode that already caused the prior T001 to fail (exit=1). The URL must be fixed in the plan (or inlined in T001) before this task can run deterministically.

The FR-007 gate checks 'if the schema-valid row count after preprocessing (T002) is below the minimum recorded in provenance.json' — but provenance.json is written by T001 itself, which never specifies where the minimum value comes from. The threshold is circular (defined by the task that checks it), so the gate is not executable as a pass/fail check. A concrete minimum (or a rule fixing it, e.g. a fraction of n_rows) must be specified.

T007's leakage gate decides whether the entire primary hypothesis is interpretable, but the correlation threshold is '[deferred] value set at implementation' (results.schema.yaml) and no task fixes or justifies it. An implementer cannot deterministically decide is_trivial_function_of_text; add a pre-registered threshold value and justification to T007 (or a task that sets it before any downstream run).

Tasks reference contract paths 'specs/001-llmxive-follow-up-extending-scalable-vis/contracts/...' while plan.md's project structure places them under 'specs/001-llmxive-layout-distillation/contracts/'. An implementer following the plan will create schemas at paths the tasks' jsonschema checks and test_results_contract.py will not find. Reconcile the directory names.

T005 hedges 'seeds 42–44 (minimum 2 seeds; use 3 if runtime permits within the 6-hour budget)' — an undeclared runtime judgment call that changes the statistical unit count for T007/T008. Fix the seed list deterministically (e.g. always 42,43,44) so downstream tasks know the pairing sample size at execution time.

T004's verification requires 'the documented command in the feature's quickstart.md' to run end-to-end, but no task creates or updates quickstart.md before T004 (T012 only documents it at the end). Either add quickstart.md authoring to T004 or point the verification at the explicit command 'python src/cli/run_pipeline.py --smoke' already named in the implementation.

T005's verification says 'paired across seeds (t-test or Wilcoxon per Shapiro–Wilk), at α = 0.025' but does not state the pass criterion for the sanity check (e.g. p < α AND mse_val_mean < mse_random_init_mean), nor what happens if the sanity check fails — terminate or continue with a flag? Specify the decision rule so the task is verifiable.
